palette._notes: accent (#2ea3f2), primary/navy (#212957), and the light teal icon accent (#7EBEC5) are the client's own brand colors, detected from adv-elec.net's header/nav CSS (background-color:#212957 on the header bar and menu) and body CSS custom values. accent_ink (#0f6fb8) is a darkened variant of the client accent, derived to clear 4.5:1 text contrast on white/surface — the raw accent only clears 2.75:1 as text. on_accent uses the client's own navy (contrast 5.03:1 on the accent fill) rather than white, since white-on-accent only clears 2.75:1.
